title: Fix the start boundary of Hsiao's WEF Data Equity term
summary: Use official WEF annual-report and first-meeting records plus the October 2023 contributor roster to establish the earliest defensible Data Equity term boundary for Hsiao without inferring the unresolved Data Policy handoff.

selection_reason: The earlier person-level artifact remains unavailable; the Data Equity side has dated official records capable of fixing a hard lower boundary.

data.target: Katherine Hsiao Data Equity term start boundary
data.query: WEF Data Equity council two-year term 2023 Katherine Hsiao first meeting annual report
data.research_question: By what date can Hsiao's membership on the 2023-2024 Data Equity council be directly established?
objectives: Use WEF's 2022-2023 annual report to bound the council launch.
Use WEF's October 2023 Global Future Councils meeting record to date the first in-person meeting of the term.
Use the October 2023 Data Equity contributor roster to directly fix Hsiao to the council.
Keep the exact pre-2023 transition unresolved.
out_of_scope: Inferring Hsiao's Data Policy dates from the Data Equity launch
selection_reason: The Data Equity start boundary is now the strongest directly dateable chronology edge.
